value.rationale: The upper signed total domination number is an established extremal invariant, and complete multipartite graphs are a canonical class already studied for the opposite minimum parameter. The result gives both a complete structural criterion for minimal STDFs and an exact arbitrary-part-size formula with a genuine parity bottleneck, rather than a routine evaluation of a single instance or a mere restatement of a known minimum formula.
